Goal.Description: Provide an AI agent engineering platform for GRACE-governed development
Goal.SuccessCriteria: Developer can initialize, plan, verify, review, and iterate on a project with traceable artifacts

Entity.name: Project
Entity.Description: Repository managed by Synapse and MyGRACE artifacts

Entity.name: Module
Entity.Description: Contracted code or artifact unit with MODULE_ID

Entity.name: Verification
Entity.Description: Executable proof associated with a module or phase

Actor.name: Developer
Actor.Description: Human developer using Synapse through CLI or MCP-compatible agents
Actor.Capabilities: Initialize projects, run verification, inspect status, install releases

Actor.name: AIAgent
Actor.Description: LLM-based coding agent using Synapse MCP tools and MyGRACE rules
Actor.Capabilities: Search code, query graph, generate artifacts, verify changes, review code

UseCase.Goal: Create sharded architecture, verification, and MCP integration artifacts
UseCase.Preconditions: - Synapse binary is available - Project directory is writable
UseCase.Postconditions: - docs/graph-index.xml exists - docs/plan-index.xml exists - docs/verification-index.xml exists - AGENTS.md and OpenCode integration exist

MainFlow.Step: System creates MCP configuration and rules
System indexes source files when present

Flow.Step: System merges synapse MCP entry without deleting existing servers

UseCase.Action: Verify and review a bounded change
UseCase.Goal: Confirm code and artifacts remain synchronized after implementation
UseCase.Preconditions: - Project has sharded MyGRACE artifacts - Source files contain MODULE_CONTRACT blocks
UseCase.Postconditions: - verify_project reports pass/fail checks - review_code reports integrity sections - refresh_project reports canonical drift

MainFlow.Step: AIAgent reads graph-index and current phase shard
AIAgent fixes blocking issues before continuing

Flow.Step: System reports missing graph or verification refs
AIAgent updates source or sharded artifacts

Requirement.Description: Linux and macOS installation must work through release artifacts or source fallback
Verification, review, and refresh commands must not panic on malformed local project state
Local project status should use sharded indexes to minimize token and context overhead

Constraint.Description: Sharded MyGRACE indexes are the primary source of truth; monolithic compatibility docs are secondary
Windows packaging remains deferred until release artifacts and installer logic exist

Glossary.Term: Repository managed by Synapse and MyGRACE artifacts
Contracted code or artifact unit with a MODULE_ID
Executable proof associated with a module or phase
Sharded graph-RAG anchored code engineering methodology
